decisions.reason: After several years and with no website presence since 2019, this core but non-strategic handle line no longer benefits much from temporary-explanation logic, so despite sunk tooling and launch effort management would likely let it go.

Its multi-model family structure and fit with the established portfolio support some persistence, but two years of non-observation weaken justification for continued commitment and make discontinuation slightly more likely.

As a single handle design with limited strategic visibility, prolonged absence from the market presentation makes it relatively easy for management to discontinue once early hopes have not clearly materialized.
This design is close to the core business but not central to the firm's announced direction, and by 2022 poor visibility can no longer be plausibly framed as only a short ramp-up issue.

Although the firm has invested in a full handle family and would normally resist admitting a failed launch, continued non-observation suggests portfolio cleanup is now somewhat more likely than further escalation.

Because this electronic access system was presented as a flagship tied to the firm's digital direction, management is still more likely to continue or relaunch it than to abandon such a visible strategic commitment.
